speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To begin our evaluation of your systemic hypertension, how old are you and have you had any recent headaches, nosebleeds, or chest pain? Please also let me know if you have noticed any changes in your vision or shortness of breath.

speaker: Patient
text: 5-year-old boy. The patient is presented by his mother for a well-child visit. The boy was born at 39 weeks gestation via spontaneous vaginal delivery, is currently up to date on all vaccines, and is meeting all developmental milestones. His mother reports that he has been generally doing well with no concerns. No family history of cardiovascular disease. The boy does not take any medications.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Thank you for the information. Since hypertension in a 5-year-old is almost always secondary to an underlying condition, I will perform a directed cardiovascular exam. I will listen for abdominal bruits to check for renal artery stenosis and assess for radio-femoral delay to rule out coarctation of the aorta.
